-- DataStore Manager Pro Plugin
local toolbar = plugin:CreateToolbar('DataStore Manager Pro')
local button = toolbar:CreateButton(
    'Open DataStore Manager',
    'Open the DataStore Manager Pro Interface',
    ''
)

local widgetInfo = DockWidgetPluginGuiInfo.new(
    Enum.InitialDockState.Right,
    true,
    true,
    800, 600, 800, 600
)

local widget = plugin:CreateDockWidgetPluginGui('DataStoreManagerWidget', widgetInfo)
widget.Title = 'DataStore Manager Pro'
widget.Enabled = true

local mainModule = require(script.Parent.init)
mainModule.createUI(widget)

-- Add a label so the widget is visible
local label = Instance.new('TextLabel')
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
label.Text = 'DataStore Manager Pro UI'
label.Parent = widget

button.Click:Connect(function()
    widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled
    print('Widget.Enabled is now', widget.Enabled)
end)

print('DataStore Manager Pro plugin loaded!')
